claims.behavior: Exact four-choice dropdown defaults to delayed propagation, imports each legacy code and stages under Options Apply/Cancel/reopen. Apply refreshes the current browser viewer. Its real hover list first consumes scrolling; an edge uses the selected never/no-scrollbar/delayed/immediate gate before reaching existing next/previous/Ctrl-zoom actions. Delayed propagation mirrors strict 0.57-second same-direction quiet time, direction reversal and new-media grace. Viewer-owned state preserves the reference 250-second direction reset; positions survive long lists and clamp for shorter ones. Retired owners cannot dispatch. Every earlier still-visible viewer also reads saved preferences per input through its independent active lifetime; the latest-viewer slot does not disable it.
limits: This concrete preference claim covers the existing ordinary browser-viewer hover. Preview/filter canvases without native hover panes, full tag selection/context actions, and the wider hover/list families remain Partial or Missing.
Native scrolling uses measured native font rows and Winit line-wheel normalization. Platform-specific line preferences and Qt fractional wheel accumulation are not claimed.
Hosted Rust/native execution and PNG inspection remain pending; only actual Qt reference execution and formatter/diff/cached warning-aware Slint compilation ran locally.

referenceRecording.reference: Actual MediaViewerHoversPanel saved choices; real CanvasHoverFrameTags.wheelEvent and QScrollArea wheelEvent on detached synthetic in-memory media; controlled clock and explicit edge delivery. Captures 48 policy/bar/time/direction gates, accepted child scrolling vs ignored edge, and real SetMedia scroll retention/clamping.

ownershipRepair.behavior: Each visible viewer is gated by its own CanvasTracker active/closed lifetime, independent of statistics enablement and the main latest-viewer slot. Older live viewers read saved preferences on actual drag/wheel input; only closed/hidden owners are rejected. Closing an earlier viewer preserves the successor; retained re-shown closed handles stay retired.
referenceRules: hydrus/client/gui/canvas/ClientGUICanvas.py::HandleMouseMoveWithoutEvent reads global saved booleans inside each moved drag (3213/3225)
hydrus/client/gui/canvas/ClientGUICanvasHoverFrames.py::CanvasHoverFrameTags.wheelEvent reads saved scrolling policy each input (3081)
Qt drag and wheel histories are instance-owned; native open_viewer permits multiple still-visible owners and separately closes noncurrent windows.
